collection.title: BMW 3 Series Touring 1995 to 1999 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A 1995 to 1999 version of a BMW 3 Series Touring requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 20" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this 3 Series Touring which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
